# cq (python-code-quality)

> CLI that runs 14 Python code quality tools (compileall, ruff, ty, bandit, kingfisher, uv audit, pytest, coverage, vulture, interrogate, radon cc/mi/hal, ruff format), combines them into one score, and prints the single most important defect as a markdown prompt for an LLM. It never edits files.

Install: `uv tool install python-code-quality` (requires Python 3.12+ and uv).

Core loop for an agent:

1. Run `cq check . -o llm` in the project root.
2. Fix only the issue it prints.
3. Repeat until `cq check . -o score` exits 0.

Useful commands:

- `cq check . -o llm --limit 3`: show up to 3 issues
- `cq check . -o llm -s src/foo.py:42:E501`: silence one issue
- `cq check . -o llm-json`: top issue as JSON with a fingerprint `id`
- `cq is-fixed <id>`: check whether that issue is gone, re-running one tool on one file
- `cq config`: effective tools and thresholds; override them under `[tool.cq]` in pyproject.toml
